note.simple: Everyone on your street shares the same fibre, so each house only opens envelopes with its own number.
note.technical: Downstream is broadcast to every ONT on the splitter and AES-encrypted per XGEM port; upstream uses time slots.

pli.name: Payload length
pli.about: Bytes of payload in this XGEM frame: the whole Ethernet frame inside.

keyidx.name: Key index
keyidx.about: Which of the ONT's AES keys encrypted the payload.

port.about: Everyone on the splitter hears every frame going down; each ONT only keeps its own Port-IDs.

lf.name: Last fragment
lf.about: 1 when this is the last (here: the only) piece of the Ethernet frame.
